description: READ-PATH, long-value chains. Writer a runs UPDATE T SET M = String(3500, 'y') over the idx fixture (every 2,000-character memo is replaced by a longer one); b suspends a 40 ms after the start signal, confirms a had not returned, opens read-only and reads MIN/MAX memo length, the aggregates and an IX_N cursor, then resumes a and reads fresh after a pause. Asks whether a reader sees a memo of either length only (no torn value) and whether it waits or errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
